newsitem.title: JAPAN: Diffusion index dip second in Japan recovery -- BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Diffusion index dip second in Japan recovery -- BOJ.

text.p: The Bank of Japan said after releasing its "tankan" corporate sentiment survey on Wednesday that it was the second time the big manufacturers' diffusion index had dipped while the country's economy was on a recovery trend.
Asked whether this was the first time the index had dipped twice during an expansionary phase, a BOJ official told reporters:

"Previously the big manufacturers' diffusion index has been on a consistent rising trend when the economy was expanding. It is true that during this expansionary phase this is the second time the index has fallen."
The official said he only had data since 1974.
He also said this was the first time since August 1995 that the big manufacturers' diffusion index had dropped compared with the previous survey.
